output.summary: A palm tree found wild in tropical South American wetlands. Its chestnut-coloured fruit has shiny scales and yellow flesh around a hard nut. The fruit is eaten or made into drinks and foods; flower-cluster buds are eaten as a vegetable, and sap is drunk fresh or fermented.
output.edibilityNote: Fruit is eaten or processed into drinks and foods; flower-cluster buds are vegetables, and sap is drunk fresh or fermented.
